Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have for you today. Hope you all enjoyed this cracking contest. Join us on the 24th of June for the second match of the ODI series to be played at Edgbaston. Until next time, take care and ciao!

Man of the Match, Chris Woakes thinks it was a good game and he is happy that he got a good partnership with Buttler. Adds that they lost Buttler but the guys who came next took on the responsibility. Ends by saying that Plunkett hitting that final delivery for a maximum was exceptional.

England captain, Eoin Morgan says it was pleasing to tie the game. Adds that Buttler, Woakes and Plunkett got them the result from a very sticky situation. Further adds that this enforces a lot of confidence in them. Thinks that Buttler got his experience into play and made it look like they could have actually won the game. Ends by saying that their bowling was a little bit rusty but the score they restricted SL was surely chaseable.

Sri Lanka captain, Angelo Mathews thinks they had the game for most of the part but it was unfortunate as Plunkett got his team home. Adds that they were 15-20 runs short and that they lost wickets at crucial times. Thinks they were poor in the field even after batting and bowling well.

The Islanders will be utterly shattered with this result. They were right on the money in the first 20 overs but lost the plot completely, thereafter. A few tough dropped changes and extra runs cost them dearly. Lakmal, Pradeep and Mathews scalped 2 each but it was their captain's injury that proved to be the driving force for this result going against them. Join us for the post match presentation in a while.

Early wickets had put SL in the driver's seat but later, captain Morgan, Woakes and Buttler's terrific knocks helped England to avoid a defeat. Plunkett's cameo of 22 runs off 11 deliveries can't be forgotten as he was the one who hit a biggie off the final delivery of the match.

What a finish to this first ODI between England and Sri Lanka. The tourists have managed to let go of this match as the Three Lions have successfully tied the match. With 82/6, no one thought it could turn out to be such a thrilling contest but it was the 138-run stand between Buttler and Woakes which helped the home team tie the match from the jaws of defeat.

SIX! Can you believe it? That one extra run off the previous delivery has cost Sri Lanka big time! MATCH TIED! The Islanders have let the match get away from the hands. Coming to the ball, it was a full delivery outside off, perfect length perfect width. Plunkett stays in the crease and muscles it high over the long off fence for a huge maximum. The England dugout is up on their feet as their captain applauds the effort from the stands. Chandimal and his herd look a sorry bunch.
Full and down the leg side, Woakes flicks it to deep backward square leg and surprisingly pick up three runs. The Lankans don't look happy. 7 needed off the final delivery!
Full toss on off, tapped back to Pradeep. Woakes was out of his crease but Pradeep misses a simple shy at the striker's end. Can Woakes make him pay?
Another yorker on middle and leg, Plunkett inside edges it onto his pad. A single taken.
Yorker on middle, Woakes can only dig it out to the off side and pick up a run. 11 runs needed off 4 balls now.
Slower delivery on of, Woakes slams it to long on. He attempts a brace and gets it finally.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl the final over.
Full toss on off, played to long on for a run. 14 runs needed off the final over.

FOUR! Good length delivery on middle and leg, Woakes paddles it over short fine leg. Maharoof chases it down but makes a mess of it to allow the ball to touch the ropes. This is turning out to be an expensive over.
Full and down the leg side, following the batsman. Plunkett drives it to long on for a single. 19 needed off 8 deliveries now.
Full and outside off, Woakes squeezes it through point for a run.

TWO WIDES! Full and down the leg side, Plunkett fails to connect as Chandimal has to dive to collect the ball. Woakes, in the meanwhile, steals a bye as well. So the first three balls have fetched 9 runs.
FOUR! Full toss on leg, Plunkett paddle scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and on off, chipped just past the short cover fielder. Danushka does extremely well to save a certain boundary in the deep. Three runs taken.
Length ball on off, Woakes chips it over the cover region for a run. 30 runs needed off the final 2 overs.
Woakes pulls the length ball to long on and comes back for the second run as well.
FOUR! Much needed! Full and on off, Woakes stays in the crease this time and lofts it straight down the ground for a one-bounce boundary.
Short ball on off, Plunkett pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Woakes comes a stp ahead and slams it to long on for a run.
Short ball on off, Plunkett dances down the track and pulls it to deep square leg on a bounce.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
Plunkett drives the ball straight down the ground. That's a superb comeback from Lakmal.

FOUR! Sloppy from Dasun, can you believe it! Full and outside off, Plunkett lofts it toward long on. Shanaka comes charging in aggressively but the ball bounces in front of him and goes past him for a boundary.
Wide! Way down the leg side, easy call for Plunkett to leave it alone.
Full and swinging in on off, Woakes digs it out to backward point for a single
Low full toss on leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, chipped to long off for a single.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower delivery way outside off, Woakes gets a thick outside edge but the ball falls safely in the gap between short third man and backward point. A single taken.
Lian Plunkett comes out to bat.

OUT! Willey holes out! Full and outside off, after quite a few play and a miss Willey finally connects but miscues it in the air. Mendis runs in from deep cover and takes a simple catch. The umpires check upstairs if Maharoof has overstepped and replays show it's not a no ball. That was a touch and go decision but the umpire gives it in favour of the bowling team. England still need 52 runs to win with just 2 wickets in hand.
Good slower ball outside off, run down to backward point for a single.
Low full toss on off, Willey pushes it to long off for a single.
Swing and a miss! Full and outside off, 79.3 mph. Willey swings his bat wildly but fails to connect.
Farveez Maharoof into the attack now. Too many changes from the Lankan camp.
Slower delivery on middle, tucked away to the leg side for a single.
Full toss on off, dabbed to deep cover for a run.
Shortish outside off, slower as well. Woakes slaps it to wide long off for a run.
Full toss on middle, flicked away to short fine leg. Maharoof moves to his left and saves a certain boundary as he gets his hand to it. Two runs taken.
Yorker outside off, Willey digs it out to point and picks up a quick single.
Length ball outside off, Willey fails to connect on that occasion.
Nuwan Pradeep comes to bowl now.

Dropped! Short ball on off, Willey goes for a flat-bat pull and ends up playing it straight back to the bowler. Lakmal fails to grab that opportunity in his followthrough and lets go of another tough chance.
Full and on leg, Woakes pushes it to long on for a single.
On a length around off, driven back to the bowler. Lakmal does well to stop it with a dive and save runs.
Full and on the pads, flicked away to the leg side for a run.
Looking at Willey swinging his bat, mid on is now sent back.
A replica of the previous delivery. Another play and a miss as pressure is now rising on England.
Play and a miss! Full and wide outside off, Willey looks to slam it through mid off but gets beaten.
Suranga Lakmal comes back into the attack.
Down the leg side, Willey flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Quicker one on middle, clipped to the leg side for a run.
Willey works it through mid-wicket for a single.
David Willey is the new man in.

OUT! What a catch, an absolute screamer! Leg spinner wide outside off, asking to be hit. Buttler looks to drill it over long on as he goes for the big shot. Shanaka stationed in the deep jumps and takes a one-handed stunner to send the Englishman back in the hut. Buttler misses out on his deserved ton as the highest 7th wicket stand between Sri Lanka and England is broken. Prasanna is all pumped up for picking up a wicket in his final over. England still need 67 runs to win.
Flatter and quicker on leg, following the batsmen. Woakes looks to defend as the ball goes off his pads for a leg bye towards third man.
Googly around off, Woakes pushes it to deep point for a brace.
Short ball on off, Buttler pulls it away to square leg to end the over with a brace.
Good length on middle, driven to long on for a single.
Buttler pushes the length ball through covers for a single.

Dropped! That would have been a screamer! Full and outside off, Buttler hammers it to covers. Prasanna moves to his left and dives to catch that one. The ball sticks in his palms but pops out at the last moment.
Shortish on the pads, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run

Not out! Length delivery on off, shaping away a shade. Buttler looks cramped for room as he looks to push it to the off side. He fails to connect as Chandimal goes up in a caught behind appeal. The Lankans go up for a review as the on-field umpires gives it not out. Replays show there was no edge on that one.
Review taken by SL for a caught behind appeal.
Farveez Maharoof is back on.
Shortish outside off, Buttler goes for a reverse sweep but fails to connect.
Flatter on off, slammed to covers for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed to extra cover for a run.
On middle, pushed to long on. Prasanna should have stopped that on but concedes a single.
Flatter outside off, Buttler dances down the track and swats it to long off for a single.
Leg spinner way outside off, Buttler goes hard at it but fails to connect. A huge solo appeal from Chandimal for caught behind is turned down.
Prasanna is back on as well.
Powerplay 3 signalled! 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
On the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for no run.
Length ball on middle, driven through mid on for a run.
Fullish delivery down the leg side, the ball goes off Buttler pads and to Chandimal.
Third full toss in a row, Buttler flicks it to deep square leg and picks up another brace.
The physio is out in the middle to look at Woakes. Hope he is okay!
Another full toss played to mid on. This time Woakes goes for a quick single as the shy at the bowler's end is missed. Woakes is hit on that occasion on the elbow and looks in pain.
Low full toss on middle, driven to mid on for no run.
In the channel outside off, Buttler drives it past the point fielder and comes back for a second run as well.
Full and wide outside off, Buttler mistimes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, punched to long on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Woakes gets a thick outside edge through the vacant gully region for a couple more. England go past 200!
Short and wide outside off, Buttler slaps it to the same region for a run.
Full and outside off, slapped to deep cover-point for a single.
Maiden ODI fifty for Chris Woakes in his 44th ODI.
Shortish outside off, Woakes runs it down to third man to get to his milestone.
Short ball on off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Buttler looks to repeat his shot but fails to connect.
FOUR! Cheeky! Full and down the leg side, Buttler gets across swiftly and paddle scoops it over Chandimal for a boundary. Risky but effective.
Off cutter outside off, slapped to deep cover for a single.
Woakes bunts the length delivery to mid off for no run.
Shortish outside off, Buttler opens the face of his bat to pick up a run to third man.
Short ball on the body, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Leg cutter outside off, Buttler outside edges it to third man for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Buttler bunts it to mid off and picks up a quick single.
Leg cutter on off, Buttler defends it to covers.
Full ball on off, driven towards extra cover. Lakmal misfields but gets up and chases it down to save a run. Three runs taken.
Farveez Maharoof is back on.
Short ball outside off, played to deep point for a single.
100-run stand up between Buttler and Woakes.

Short ball on middle, Buttler mistimes his pull to short fine leg. Lakmal fires in a direct hit at the striker's end but Woakes makes it back in with ease. This is turning out to be a match-winning stand.
Short ball on the body, pulled away for a single to mid-wicket.
Fires in a length delivery on off, Woakes bunts it to mid off for no run.
FOUR! Full and on middle, Woakes tickles it to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Serves a length delivery on off, Buttler closes the face of his bat and plays it to mid on for a single.
Another bowling change for SL, Nuwan Pradeep comes back into the attack.
Tossed up on middle, Woakes dances down the track and ends up flicking in the air. The ball goes few yards past the short mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
Pitched up around off, driven to long off for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, worked to long on for  a run.
Flatter outside off, Buttler comes down the track and slams it to long off for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Arm ball on off, pushed to covers for no run.
Drinks break!
Flatter on middle, Buttler hammers it with full power to long on for a single.
Yorker on middle, Buttler digs it out to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Pitched up outside off, Buttler dances down the track and plays it inside out over covers for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, driven to long on for a single.
Drifts it down the leg side, Buttler clips it to deep square leg and picks up a brace with ease.
Arm ball on off, from round the wicket. Woakes punches it to long off for  a single.
Danushka Gunathilaka to bowl now.
Buttler defends the loopy delivery to covers for no run.
Full and on middle, Woakes leans across and flicks it to wide long on for another single.
Pitched up on middle, Buttler flicks it to long on for a run.
Floated on middle, Buttler bunts it back to Prasanna.
Loopy delivery on middle, Buttler dances down the track and plays it to mid-wicket for no run.
Tossed up on off, pushed to wide long off for a single.

Slower deliver on off, Woakes defends it to covers and picks up a single.
Woakes shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide outside off, punched to deep point for a single.
Back of a length on off, Buttler pulls it to mid-wicket. The fielder gets his hand to it and parries it towards long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Buttler gets a thick outside edge to third man for a run.
On the pads, flicked to short mid-wicket for no run.
Sloppy! Length ball on off, pushed to covers. A fumble allows Buttler to keep the strike with a single.
Low full toss on off, Buttler flicks it to short mid-wicket on a bounce.
FOUR! Edged but safe! Full and wide outside off, Buttler gets a thick outside edge looking to push it through mid off. The ball races through the vacant slip cordon for a boundary.
Full toss on middle, Buttler flicks it away with ease. Pradeep moves to his right from deep square leg and dives to keep it to a brace.
Length ball on off, punched to covers for no run.
WIDE! Fires it way down the leg side, Buttler kneels across and looks to paddle scoop it over fine leg. The Englishman fails to connect as the umpire signals it a wide.
Length ball on off, punched to sweeper cover. Three more runs for Woakes.
Suranga Lakmal is back on, replacing the ineffective Prasanna.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short and on middle, Buttler swivels and pulls it to the deep square leg fence to pick up another boundary.
Slower and short outside off, just 0.8 mph quicker than the previous delivery. Buttler blocks it off his front foot.
Slower delivery way outside off, 63 mph. Buttler drives it straight to covers.
Wide outside off, Woakes runs it down to third man for another run.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
In the channel around off, Buttler bunts it back to Shanaka.
Dasun Shanaka comes on to bowl now.
Chris has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Leg spinner on off, Buttler bunts it towards long off. Prasanna dives to save a single but fumbles to let go of a run.
Tossed up on middle, Woakes dances down the track and works it to wide long on for a run.
Flatter outside off, Buttler slaps it to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery on off, clipped to short mid-wicket for no run.
SIX! Massive! What a way to get to his 8th ODI fifty! Pitched up around off, Buttler dances down the track and murders is over long off for a biggie.
On a length around off, driven to wide long on for a single to end the over.
Good length delivery on off, Woakes walks across and pushes it to long on for a single.
Wide outside off cut away to point for no run.
Length ball on middle, Woakes defends it to mid on. Maharoof dives to his right in his followthrough but fails to collect the ball.
Full and on off, Buttler plays an uppish drive to mid off and picks up a quick single.
Short and wide outside off, cut away to deep point for a brace. Superb effort from Perera in the deep to save a certain boundary.
Chris has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pitched up on middle, Buttler dances down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Shortish around off, pushed to deep cover for another single.
Tossed up around off, driven to wide long off for a run.
Down the leg side, Buttler pushes it straight to short mid-wicket.
Leg spinner on middle, Buttler opens the face of his bat and works it to point.
Woakes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, shaping away. Buttler looks for a drive but the ball move past his outside edge.
Slower delivery outside off, 69.9 mph. Buttler fails to cut it through point as the ball goes past his outside edge.
Back of a length on off, Woakes defends it to the off side.
Length ball on off, Buttler flicks it away past shirt mid-wicket for another couple.
Length ball on middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket. Superb running between the wickets to pick up a brace.
Pitched up on off, Woakes digs it out to long on for a run. At the halfway stage England are 115/6, 172 runs away from their target.
Loopy delivery outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Tosses it up on off, Woakes plays it with soft hands to cover-point for a run.
Pitched up on off, flicked away straight to short mid-wicket.
Short ball on leg, Buttler gets back and pulls it to long on for a run.
Straighter delivery on middle, Buttler dances down the track but fails to connect and gets hit on the pad.
Slower delivery outside off, 67.9 mph. Buttler caresses it through point to pick up a brace.
Full and on off, driven straight to mid on for no run.
Wide outside off, Buttler dabs it to third man and gets a single.
FOUR! Much needed! Length ball around off, Buttler pushes it through covers and picks up a boundary.
Full ball on off, 70.1 mph. Buttler ends up chipping it in the air but plays it well short of the mid off fielder.
Slower delivery on off, shaping away. Woakes runs it down to third man for a single.
Farveez Maharoof is back on.
Pitched up on off, Buttler comes a step ahead and pushes it past extra cover for a brace.
Woakes pushes the floated delivery through mid off for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, Buttler dances down the track and pushes it to covers with the help of his pads. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Slower and shorter on off, Buttler looks to play the reverse sweep but it hit on the forearm.
Short and on the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Leg spinner on off, driven to covers. Superb effort from the fielder to save a single.
Slower delivery down the leg side, the ball goes off Buttler's pads to the keeper.
Wayward line from Pradeep! Short and on leg, Buttler ducks under it to evade. Luckily it's not called a wide.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side, Buttler wanted to flick but leaves it alone at the last moment.
On a length around off, Woakes gets high in the crease to block but the ball goes off the top half off the bat to mid-wicket. Another single to England.
Full ball on off, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on off, Buttler ducks under it to evade.
Wide outside off run down to third man for a run.
Full and on middle, Woakes pushes it straight down the ground to end the over with a single.
Floated outside off, Buttler dances down the track and slams it through covers for a single.
Pitched up on off, driven straight down the track for a run.
Flighted delivery on off, Woakes comes a couple of steps ahead and takes it on the full only to inside edge onto his pads.
Loopy delivery on off, pushed to covers for no run.
Tossed up on off, Woakes defends it.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Fullish ball outside off, Buttler drives it firmly through the cover region for a glorious boundary.
Back of a length ball outside off, Woakes cuts it towards point where the fielder fails to stop the ball and the batsmen take a single.
Fuller length ball on off, Woakes drives it back to the bowler who uses his football skills to stop the ball.
Length delivery outside off, Woakes pushes it to the cover fielder.
Good length ball outside off, Woakes pushes it to the point region.
On middle and off, Buttler works it through the leg side for a single.
On middle and leg, Buttler gets an inside edge towards square leg. Single taken.
Full on off, Buttler stays back in his crease and defends.
Outside off, Woakes pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Landed just outside off, Woakes blocks it into the ground.
Fullish ball around off, Buttler drives it through mid off for a single.
Landed outside off, Buttler punches it away off his back foot.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA into the attack as well.
CHRIS WOAKES walks in next.

OUT! Ali drags it on! Short of a length ball outside off, Ali tries to cut this one but doesn't time it that well. He gets an inside edge onto his stumps. Pradeep gets another wicket! England slip further. Superb stuff by Sri Lanka!
Good length ball outside off, Ali pushes it to mid off.
On middle and off, Ali flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Landed around off, Ali defends it from within his crease.
FOUR! That's a fine shot! Good length ball outside off, Ali crunches it hard through the cover region for a boundary.
Length ball around off, Ali blocks it to the off side.
Length ball on off, Buttler gets across and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. A couple for Buttler to end the over.
Good length on off, Ali pushes it through covers for a run.
Full ball around off, Moeen defends it watchfully.
Shortish around off, punched to point for no run.
Shortish outside off, Ali shoulders his arms to it.
Full ball on off, flicked away to square leg for a single.
Moeen Ali is the next man in.
Drinks break! England still need 215 runs to take this match with just 5 wickets in hand.

OUT! That's the wicket SL needed, that's the wicket Pradeep has provided! A good length delivery on off, shaping away. Morgan looks to run it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge to it. The ball is caught safely by moving to his left and Pradeep is is all pumped up. Morgan shakes his head as he walks back with a forlorn face. England have now lost half their side and SL successfully break the dangerous looking partnership.
On a length outside off, Buttler again gets across and pulls it to short mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball outside off, Buttler gets across and flicks it to deep backward square leg for a brace.
Shortish on off, Buttler blocks it off his front foot.

Just wide! Full and wide outside off, Buttler enjoys the room as he lofts it in the air to the off side. The tall Maharoof moves to his left and dive but the ball goes inches past him and runs away for a boundary.
Jos defends it from within the crease.
No change of ends for Shanaka. Pradeep to continue from this end.
Wide outside off, Morgan looks to replicate his shot off the last delivery. He fails to connect this time around.
Short ball outside off, slapped to deep cover. Perera in the deep does extremely well to keep it to a brace with a dive.
Length ball outside off, Butler taps it straight to gully on a bounce.
Full ball outside off, Buttler defends and picks up a quick single.
Shortish outside off, Morgan dances down the track and dabs it to deep cover-point for a single.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Farveez Maharoof comes into the attack now. Change of ends for Shanaka? Wait till the end of this over to find out...
Full ball around off, driven through covers for a single. Superb first over from Pradeep, just 2 runs off it.
On a length around off, Morgan defends it to short cover. Well bowled by Pradeep.
A replica of the last delivery. This time Morgan hangs his bat in the air and lets it through.
Shortish outside off, Morgan looks to cut it away but again gets beaten.
Full ball on off, pushed to wide mid off for a quick single.
On a length around off, defended.
Double change as Nuwan Pradeep comes into the attack. In the meanwhile, Mathews goes off the field as well.
FOUR! Too wide outside off, fullish as well. Morgan drives it through covers for a crisp boundary.
On a length around off, Morgan was ready on his front foot as he blocks it to the off side.
Yorker outside off, Buttler smashes it through covers for a single.
Over-pitched around off, Morgan digs it out through covers for a run.

Full and wide outside off, Buttler reach to it but gets another thick inside edge. the ball goes over the stumps to the on side as he picks up a run.
First change for the Islanders, Dasun Shanaka comes into the attack.

Dropped! That's harsh though! A length delivery on off, Buttler gets across and looks to paddle it to the leg side. The ball goes off the inside edge, hits the keeper's pads and lobs over him for a single
Wide outside off, Morgan works it to point for a single.

Short of a length delivery on leg, Morgan hops and pulls it to mid-wicket for a brace. A wild throw at the bowler's end is saved by Pradeep with a dive. That could have been an unnecessary boundary. SL need to keep the pressure on and not give away easy runs.
Length ball on off, Buttler pulls it to the leg side and gives strike to his captain.
In the channel around off, Buttler defends it watchfully.
FOUR! That's what he wanted to do on the fourth delivery of this over. Full and outside off, Morgan drives it beautifully past the wide mid off fielder to fetch himself a boundary.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Morgan.
Play and a miss! Great cricket from SL! A fullish delivery outside off, Morgan looks to drive it through wide mid off but the ball nips away to go past the outside edge.
Length ball around off, Morgan dabs it to covers for no run.
Back of a length on off, Morgan is cramped for room as he ends up blocking it down the ground.

Jos Buttler, the English keeper walks out to bat.

OUT! And another one bites the dust! England are falling like a pack of cards! Good length delivery around off, extra bounce off the deck as well. Morgan has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! Just past the slip fielder! Shortish outside off, Morgan gets a thick outside edge to it as the ball flies inches past the first slip fielder and runs away to the third man fence.
Length ball fired on off. Morgan gets in the line of the delivery and blocks it.
In the channel around off, Morgan defends.
On a length around off, Morgan does the right thing and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! Full ball on middle, nipping away. Morgan drives it straight down the ground. the mid off fielder moves to his left and slides as he gets his hand to the ball. It was so powerfully hit that the ball still races away to the fence.
Shortish around off, Bairstow was ready on his back foot and he defends it to the on side. A run and a wicket off that over.
Jonny Bairstow comes out to bat at number 5.

OUT! Captain to the rescue again. Root's poor form continues. A length delivery on off, shaping in a shade. Root, on his back foot, loosely hangs his bat as the ball goes off his inside edge and rattles the stumps. The Lankans are over the moon as Root looks a sorry figure struck in the crease. England are three down and the chase is getting more and more difficult for them.
Inside edge onto the pads! Good length delivery on off, shaping in. Root gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Mathews smiles as that would have been really close.
Back of sa length outside off, Morgan cuts it to deep backward point for a single.
Play and a miss! Length ball around off, 76.9 mph. Morgan looks to cut it through point but the ball goes past his outside edge.
Slower delivery on off, Morgan defends it towards mid off with a straight bat.
Wide outside off, Morgan dabs it through point for a single.
Length delivery on the pads, Root flicks it to deep square leg. Maharoof slips as he collects the ball but only gives away a single.
Shortish outside off, Morgan slices it to deep backward point for an easy single.
Extra bounce on that occasion! A length delivery outside off, Morgan jumps and punches it to the off side for no run.
Back of a length on off, Morgan gets high in the crease and dabs it to covers for no run.
Wide outside off, Morgan leaves it alone, yet again.
In the channel outside off, Morgan runs it down to third man for a run.
Slower delivery outside off, 73.5 mph. Morgan fails to read it but luckily retracts his bat at the last moment to let it through.
On a length outside off, Morgan reaches to it and taps it on a bounce straight to backward point.
Wide outside off, Morgan decides to let it through and watches the ball go to the keeper.
FOUR! Attack, says Morgan! Short of a length delivery on off, Morgan swivels and pulls it hard over short mid-wicket for a boundary to get off the mark.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Morgan lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Captain Eoin Morgan is the next man in.

OUT! Both openers now back in the hut! That's is simply unlucky for England and Hales has wasted a review unnecessarily. A length delivery on off, Hales goes for a flick off his front foot and the ball balloons in the air as it goes off the top of Hales' pads. Perera stationed at short mid-wicket comes running in and pouches it. The Lankans appeal and the umpire raises his finger. To everyone's surprise Hales decides to take the review and the Hot Spot clearly shows the ball went off the blade. England have lost two quick wickets and SL are right on the top in the first three overs.
A review has been taken for a catch. It was adjudged out!
On a length outside off, tapped to point for no run.
Wide outside off, defended to the off side.
FOUR! First for England! Good length delivery on off, Hales looks to smash it to the leg side but the ball goes off the inside half of his bat and runs away to the square leg boundary.
Shortish delivery outside off, punched to the off side for no run.
Good length outside off, Root punches it to the off side to end the over with a dot ball. Two runs and a wicket off that Mathews' over.
A replica of the last delivery, Root defends it watchfully.
Joe Root is the new man in at number 3.

OUT! Captain strikes straightaway! On a a length around off, no real swing on that occasion. Roy fails to connect and gets rapped on the back pad. A huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger in a flash. Replays show the ball was hit on the knee roll but would have gone to hit the stumps. Good that Roy decided not to take the review. That's a perfect start for Sri Lanka and it's their captain drawing the first blood.
Roy has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery outside off, Roy simply hangs his bat in the way to guide it to point.
Slower delivery on middle, Roy flicks it in the gap through mid-wicket for a brace.
Angelo Mathews to bowl with the second new ball. A deep first slip in place as well.
On the pads, Roy gets off the mark with a punch to mid on.
That's simply brilliant! Lakmal sticks to his line and bowls a length delivery on middle, Roy only defends it to the on side.
Good length on off, extra bounce as well. Roy punches it to covers for no run. England still not off the mark...
On a length around off, Roy gets on his back foot to open the face of his bat and defend it to cover-point.
Back of a length around off, Roy opens the face of his bat and works it to point.
Starts with a length ball outside off, Roy defends it back to Lakmal.

Welcome back for the English run chase! It shall be Alex Hales and Jason Roy opening for the hosts. Suranga Lakmal will start off with the bowling proceedings for the Islanders. In 3-2-1, let's roll...
